# Popular package names for the typosquat check (SUSPECT-TYPOSQUAT), one per line as
# `ecosystem<TAB>name`, sorted. A dependency one keystroke from one of these, and not
# itself listed, warns; a listed name is never a squat, and a name the registry treats
# as the same (separators dropped or swapped) is the listed, older package. npm scopes
# come from the scoped names (`@babel` from `@babel/core`). Ecosystems are as OSV
# names them.
#
# Generated by scripts/popular.py on 2026-11-01; regenerate rather than edit.
# npm         10000 names  npm-high-impact 1.13.0 (lib/top.js: most downloaded, then most depended on), plus 9 wallet libraries
# PyPI         8000 names  hugovk/top-pypi-packages, 30 days to 2026-11-01
# crates.io    5000 names  crates.io API sorted by downloads over 90 days, 2026-11-01
# RubyGems     2000 names  packages.ecosyste.ms, rubygems.org sorted by downloads, 2026-11-01
